$comment: The host manifest. In publish mode, the publish workflow builds the served site from it on every push to main; every path is relative to this file. Each record is added by a publish from a notebook or a Marimo app, as the README describes.

registry.$comment: This host's own statement about the signing key of its records, served at https://publish-example.typedstandards.org/.well-known/typed-publisher.json. The key is a pseudonymous did:key whose seed is kept, so that its records can be withdrawn and revised. This registry is not a Typed Standards record, and not an endorsement by the Typed Standards specification or by typedstandards.org, although this host is a subdomain of it. activatedAt is the earliest createdAt among the records this host serves, as the signer states it.

index.$comment: The records this example host serves, each published from a hosted notebook or a local Marimo app with the typedstandards Python package.
